results.snippet: Airlift Northwest has provided critical care air ambulance services since 1982. We fly more than 4,500 patients each year across Washington, Oregon, Wyoming, Alaska, Montana and Idaho.

results.title: Airlift Northwest - Wikipedia
results.snippet: Airlift Northwest operates 24 hours a day, 365 days a year and flies approximately 4,000 patients annually. The not-for-profit agency is entirely self-funded with a $40 million annual budget. Airlift Northwest estimates that it provides about $7.5 million in uncompensated charity care every year.
